senses.definition: A small, deep, and wooded valley or sunken area of ground, especially in the form of a natural hollow.
examples:
To this day they dwell
In a lonely dell.

quotes.text: In dells and dales, conceal'd from human sight.

quotes.reference: 1621 August 13 (first performance; Gregorian calendar), Ben Jonson, “The Masque of the Gypsies”, in Q. Horatius Flaccus: His Art of Poetry. […], London: […] J[ohn] Okes, for John Benson […], published 1640, →OCLC:
